svg.title: NERvvE DevSecOps end-to-end data flow
svg.desc: Eight numbered stages from a code change to proof for auditors, with the cloud and runtime lane joining at enrichment.

text.tspan: From a code change to proof, in eight steps
Every number is a stage the data passes through. The cloud and runtime lane joins at step 4, so risk is judged with the context of where the code runs.
Azure Resource Graph · AWS APIs · Google Cloud
Asset Inventory · Kubernetes API · or an uploaded
Resources, identities and grants in one shape.
Configuration only; never data, never Kubernetes
Exposure + weakness + privilege or data, linked to
the repository by IaC tags, annotations or the
Falco and Tetragon events are redacted, grouped per workload, image and rule, and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
TLS everywhere; credentials only in the vault
Every row carries its tenant; PostgreSQL enforces
Secrets and tokens redacted before storage
Every decision audited in a hash chain
Numbers match the step-by-step walkthrough on the Data flow page.
next change starts from a cleaner baseline
cloud findings + attack paths join the queue at step 4
